name: brdcomp-hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A lightweight preview panel that appears on hover or focus, useful for quick summaries. Similar to Popover but optimized for hover.

examples.title: Hover preview
examples.code:
import { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent } from "@/components/ui/hover-card"

<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger>Hover me</HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>Preview content</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
